decisions.reason: The training programme strongly complements the firm's machines and application support, uses existing training capabilities, and helps lock in customer relationships with relatively low resource risk.
As a rotary axis accessory, it fits the firm's modular milling ecosystem and installed base, though its more niche role makes it somewhat more expendable than core machines.

Hybrid additive post-processing is comparatively distant from the firm's core machining and workflow strengths, so management would likely reallocate resources to better-aligned products and development projects.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is central to the firm's established offer, innovation profile, and customer value proposition, making continuation highly likely.
The automatic tool change system directly improves productivity and automation for core customers and is a natural add-on within the firm's existing engineering and service model.
